display.purpose: Page titles only; one per screen.

body.purpose: Default text, movement names, list content.

label.purpose: Chips, buttons, secondary rows. Machine-label variant: 12px / 700 / uppercase status tags only.

shadows.name: field-cue
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Sits on inputs and outline buttons as a tactile cue for interactive surfaces.

motion.name: fill-alpha
motion.purpose: Buttons shift primary fills to 90% and secondary fills to 80% on hover/press.

motion.name: stroke-shift
motion.purpose: Inputs shift their border and focus ring when focused.

motion.name: press-fade
motion.purpose: Web navigation rows visibly fade while pressed.

notes: The global role tokens support light and dark modes, but src/app/_layout.tsx currently forces the Gluestack provider to dark mode.
Web navigation currently uses legacy theme constants rather than global.css role tokens.
The web navigation outer radius is 32px and its active tab radius is 16px; these are existing chrome exceptions to the new-surface radius ladder.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action surface: 36px high, 6px radius, primary fill, and inverted foreground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #171717; color: #FAFAFA; font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(23,23,23,.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4D4D4; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFF5F5; color: #171717; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(255,245,245,.9); } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary choice with Burr Line stroke, Field Cue shadow, and accent fill on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0A; font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:active { background: #F7F7F7; color: #343434; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4D4D4; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-outline { background: rgba(46,46,46,.05); border-color: rgba(46,46,46,.9); color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:active { background: rgba(46,46,46,.1); color: #FAFAFA; } }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact 32px full-radius filter control; selected is primary, unselected is outlined.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; color: #0A0A0A; font: 500 12px/16px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #F7F7F7; } .ds-chip-selected { color: #FAFAFA; background: #171717; border-color: #171717; } .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: rgba(23,23,23,.9); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-chip { color: #FAFAFA; background: transparent; border-color: #2E2E2E; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-chip-selected { color: #171717; background: #FFF5F5; border-color: #FFF5F5; } }

components.name: Catalog Search Input
components.description: Recessed catalog field: card fill, no border, 12px radius, and a search icon in the actual screen.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search movements"/></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: #737373; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #0A0A0A; font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #D4D4D4; outline-offset: 0; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-search { background: #171717; } .ds-search input { color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #A1A1A1; } }

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: The ledger's atomic unit: borderless 12px plate, movement name, muted muscle-group tag, and optional archive label.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-row-name { color: #0A0A0A; font: 400 16px/24px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; color: #0A0A0A; background: #F5F5F5; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-row-status { margin-left: auto; color: #737373; font: 700 12px/16px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-row { background: #171717; } .ds-row-name { color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-tag { color: #FAFAFA; background: #262626; } .ds-row-status { color: #A1A1A1; } }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Existing web chrome: legacy-colored floating navigation with 32px outer radius, 16px active tab radius, and pressed opacity.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: min(100%, 800px); padding: 8px 32px; background: #F0F0F3; border-radius: 32px; } .ds-nav-brand { margin-right: auto; color: #0A0A0A; font: 700 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tab { min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 16px; color: #60646C; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { opacity: .7; } .ds-nav-tab-active { color: #0A0A0A; background: #E0E1E6; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-nav { background: #212225; } .ds-nav-brand { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-tab { color: #B0B4BA; } .ds-nav-tab-active { color: #FFFFFF; background: #2E3135; } }

narrative.overview:
Crowbar is a professional instrument for recording training, not a fitness app that wants to be liked. The interface behaves like a good training ledger: dense, legible, monotone, and uninterested in decoration. Every screen is a column of facts — movements, sets, landmarks — and the chrome exists only to keep them scannable at a glance between sets.

The material language is machined metal and paper. Warm neutrals run from Bare Steel white to Anodized Black; the only decisive surface is the near-black (or warm ivory, in dark mode) action color, appearing when something is selected or committed. Radii follow a small ladder, spacing follows a 4px scale, and depth is primarily tonal. The implementation supports light and dark role tokens, although the current app root forces the dark provider mode while automatic appearance remains declared in app configuration.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome warm neutrals; one decisive action surface
Flat-by-default surfaces; depth through tonal layering
System typography only — SF Pro / Roboto / system UI
4px spacing scale, 16px gutters, max content width 800px
Uppercase machine labels reserved for status tags

rules.name: The One-Surface Rule
rules.body: The primary color appears on at most one decisive element per view. Its rarity tells the user where commitment happens.

rules.name: The System-Font Rule
rules.body: Do not load custom fonts. SF Pro, Roboto, and system UI are the identity.

rules.name: The 800-Rule
rules.body: No web content column exceeds 800px; extra width stays as side whitespace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add resting drop shadows or glows. State changes use fill alpha, border shifts, focus rings, and pressed opacity rather than transforms.

rules.name: The No-Hybrid-Radius Rule
rules.body: New controls and containers must use only the established radius steps; do not introduce intermediate 4px or 8–10px radii.

dos: Do build new surfaces from the global role tokens in src/global.css.
Do use the 4/8/16/24/32/64px spacing rhythm and 16px gutters.
Do keep new controls at 6px, new containers at 12px, and new pills at full radius.
Do support both token modes, and verify both light and dark class states when changing UI.
Do keep important interactive targets at least 36px high.
Do reserve uppercase bold microcopy for muted status labels.
Do cap web content columns at 800px.
donts: Don't introduce accent hues, gradients, imagery, or emoji into the ledger interface.
Don't add ambient shadows or glow; use the Field Cue only on interactive fields and outline buttons.
Don't introduce new radius values outside the established ladder.
Don't load custom fonts or mix brand typefaces.
Don't use more than one decisive primary surface per view.
Don't uppercase ordinary body or label copy.
Don't use legacy Colors constants in new feature screens; legacy navigation is the current documented exception pending migration.
